item.title: UW News • Men's Basketball: Riddle, Ball shine at FIBA U-18 Asia Cup
item.description: MADISON, Wis. – The Wisconsin men's basketball's freshman duo of  Jackson Ball and Isaac Riddle made strong impressions overseas at the FIBA U-18 Asia Cup. Both had productive showings with Riddle helping Australia capture the gold medal and Ball starring in New Zealand's third-place finish.

item.title: UW News • Men's Basketball: Badgers to compete in 2026 Baha Mar Championship
item.description: MADISON, Wis. – Wisconsin men's basketball will head to Nassau, Bahamas, this fall to compete in the 2026 Baha Mar Championship at the Baha Mar Convention, Arts & Entertainment Center. Event promoter bdG Sports officially announced the tournament field on Thursday, which features the Badgers alongside Seton Hall, NC State, and Murray State.

item.title: UW News • Volleyball: Badgers sweep Butler in final exhibition match
item.description: MADISON, Wis. — The No. 6 Wisconsin volleyball team swept Butler in straight sets (25-14, 25-10, 25-13, 30-28) to close out its exhibition slate on Friday evening. Tonight's exhibition match included an additional fourth set guaranteed.
